result:
I've fixed F-DG1-135. The module-boundary lint now gives test-only exemptions only to `*.test.ts` and `*.test.tsx`, the same files the build excludes. All requested checks pass on Node 22 and Node 24.

**The fix** (`apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts`):
- `TEST_FILE` is now `/\.test\.tsx?$/`.
- The lint still scans every buildable file (`CODE_FILE` and `walk()` are unchanged).
- A file like `*.test.mts` or `*.test.js` is now treated as an ordinary module file and gets the full boundary rules. Vitest never runs it and it ships in `dist`, so it shouldn't be exempt from importing `modules.ts`, `architecture.testkit.ts` or `vitest`.
- I updated the header note and doc comment to say this.

**The tests** (`apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts`):
- I rewrote the old test that said any `*.test.<ext>` file counts as a test. Now only `.test.ts` and `.test.tsx` are exempt; every other test-looking extension, and every plain file, gets the vitest and composition-root violations.
- I added a test that a `zz.test.mts` file importing `../../modules.ts` or `vitest` is a violation, while a `zz.test.ts` file doing the same is allowed.

**Checks run:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm vitest run apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts` (Node 22 and Node 24) | 128/128 passed; the real module tree still has no violations |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm lint` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm exec prettier --check` on the two files | passed |
| `pnpm test`, Node 22 (v22.22.2) | 21 files, 321/321 passed |
| `pnpm test`, Node 24 (v24.21.0) | 21 files, 321/321 passed |
| `find apps/api/src/modules -name '*.test.*' ! -name '*.test.ts'` | empty, so the change has no effect on the real code |

The default `node` in this environment is v24, so for the Node 22 runs I put `/opt/node22/bin` first on the `PATH`.

There are no migrations or new API endpoints, and I edited only the two permitted files plus the handback. Closing F-DG1-135 is up to a non-author reviewer. The handback, with the full diff and output tails, is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG1/round-14/T-DG1-BE15-backend-workflow-engineer.md`.
